message.content: {"caption":"A grouped bar-and-line chart compares success rates across four memory settings.","description":"The chart plots Success Rate (SR) on a vertical axis from 35 to 60, marked at 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, and 60; the axis does not start at zero. The horizontal categories are No Memory, Synapse, AWM, and ReasoningBank. Each category has a pink Pass@1 bar and a blue Best-of-5 bar, plus a gray dashed No Scaling line with open-circle markers. Printed values are: No Memory—Pass@1 39.0, Best-of-5 42.2, No Scaling 39.0; Synapse—41.2, 44.4, and 40.6; AWM—45.5, 47.6, and 44.4; ReasoningBank—53.0, 55.1, and 49.7, respectively. All three series increase across the categories.
